whatAreWeNotDiscovering: Ollama size_vram alone did not show where VRAM was allocated.
Layer offload granularity may itself impose a floor above the 16x target.
VRAM reduction can be relocation into host RAM rather than information reduction.
discoveries: Runtime log physically verifies 1/29 GPU layers at the 11.18x point.
One-layer CUDA model buffer = 243.44 MiB; CUDA compute buffer = 28.75 MiB.
CPU-mapped model buffer at one-layer point = 1047.20 MiB.
The one-layer model buffer alone exceeds the 16x total VRAM target (~199.47 MB).
Zero GPU layers switches to CPU-only and cannot count as GPU-resident 16x.
whatNeedsEnhancement: Sub-layer tensor/block paging or streamed matrix segments.
Golden Formula GPU adapter should govern active tensor working set, transfer timing, and eviction, not only whole-layer residency.
Account simultaneously for VRAM, host RAM, PCIe transfer, storage/mmap, compute buffers, and latency.

nextGate: Implement or expose sub-layer tensor/block streaming/paging in the canonical model runtime, then target <=199,473,889 bytes GPU working set while preserving inference and accounting for relocated resources.
